component.name: MasterSafe Authenticator
component.summary: Two-factor codes and passwords in one encrypted vault

description.p: MasterSafe Authenticator keeps your two-factor codes and your passwords in one encrypted vault on your own computer. Nothing leaves it unless you choose a backup or sync folder.

ul.li: TOTP and HOTP codes, added from a QR code image, an otpauth link or by hand
Passwords, notes, cards and identities, with folders, tags, attachments and history
AES-256-GCM encryption with a key derived from your master password by Argon2id
Imports from KeePass databases (.kdbx), Bitwarden, 1Password, Proton Pass, Aegis, 2FAS and Google Authenticator
Encrypted backups and sync through your own folder or WebDAV server
A recovery key, a security events list and a password health report
Screen reader support, high contrast and larger text; English, Spanish and Finnish

description.p: Free for personal, non-commercial use. The source code is published for review; it is not open source. Windows Hello and FIDO2 security keys unlock the vault only on Windows.

Restore a daily copy from the app, the recovery key on paper or in 3 parts, help on the sign-in screen, closable folders, a check of the installed program files, and a sign-in pause that ignores clock changes.
A .deb package for Debian, Ubuntu and Linux Mint, and a processor check in the Linux installer.
Fixes for Linux and the first store packages.

ul.li: Release signatures are checked on systems without OpenSSL 3.5, such as Linux Mint 22 and Ubuntu 24.04
Inside Flatpak, Flathub provides the updates

description.p: Deeper protection and an easier move from KeePass.

ul.li: A new encryption key with every new master password
Spare security keys and a list of security events
A pause after many quick copies
A countdown ring for each code
